title: Hot Wheels Bug n Taxi VW Beetle - 1983 Mattel - Rolls Smoothly
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Diecast & Toy Vehicles:Cars, Trucks & Vans:Vintage Manufacture
descriptionText: The Hot Wheels Bug n Taxi VW Beetle from 1983 by Mattel is a classic diecast car in a multi-color design. This 1:64 scale model of the Volkswagen Beetle is perfect for boys and girls who love toy cars. Made in India, this vintage collectible rolls smoothly and is a great addition to any toy car collection. With its unique design and brand authenticity, this Hot Wheels car is a must-have for collectors and enthusiasts alike.
